title: CarpetStairs
description: Carpets on the stairs and slabs for your server
body:
🧶 CarpetStairs

Make your interiors more comfortable! The plugin allows you to lay carpets on steps and semi-blocks (slabs), creating realistic carpets that adapt to the shape of the blocks.
**(By the way, as I found out, the plugin has no competitors.That's why it was created.)**

Main functions:
Adaptive shape: The carpet automatically takes the form of a step: straight, angular (internal or external) or flat (for slabs).

Seamless renovation: When you change the shape of the staircase (for example, you added an adjacent step), the carpet is updated.

When walking on the "carpet" steps, you hear the soft sounds of wool.

Carpets are cleaned the same way as regular carpets - there are sounds of breaking, breaking timeout (in survival)

The plugin uses modern BlockDisplay entities (and Interaction to create hitboxes) that practically do not load the server and look perfect.

Technical information:
Game version: 1.21 and higher (requires support for BlockDisplay entities).

Supported kernels: Paper, Purpur and their forks.

How to use:
Take any (even moss) mat in your hand.
Press the PCM on the bottom of the step or slab.
To remove the carpet, just break it (pinch the paintwork, as with regular mining).
